title: boundary_from_content: 'collision impossibility by construction' comment is wrong
description: sign.rs boundary_from_content has a comment claiming 'Collision impossibility by construction: the boundary string cannot appear as a substring of the content it was derived from.' This is false. A content C can contain the string '----=_Part_' + hex(SHA256(C)[0..16]) — there is no cryptographic impossibility. The Err path at lines 346-353 IS the real guard. A future maintainer who trusts the comment and removes or loosens the collision check introduces a real RFC 2046 violation. Fix: remove the false security rationale and replace with an accurate comment stating 'the collision check at the end is the authoritative guard.'
